name: CKEditor(5) Emoji
description: Provides Emoji CKEditor Plugin for CKEditor5.
project_description:
CKEditor Emoji Plugin is designed to enhance the content editing experience in Drupal by enabling the insertion of emojis directly into your text. Emojis have become a universal form of expression and communication, adding a fun and engaging aspect to your content.

 Back to top 

 Installation 
 
 Go to the Drupal admin dashboard. 
 Navigate to Configuration > Content authoring > Text formats and editors. 
 Edit the text format you want to enable emojis for (e.g., Full HTML). 
 In the CKEditor settings, add the Icon button to the toolbar. 
 Save your changes. 
 Now, when you edit content using the configured text format, you'll have an emoji button in the CKEditor toolbar. Click it to insert emojis into your content.. 
 
 Back to top 

 Additional Requirements 
 
 CKEditor5
